ns2:course.label: Techniques in Animal Nutrition
ns2:course.description: Discusses and applies methods of laboratory analysis and animal experimentation frequently used in nutrition research. Same as NUTR 523. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Courses in nutrition, physiology, and biochemistry and consent of instructor.
